# ABDM Developer Portal

> Documentation for integrating with ABDM, India's health data exchange: the HIE-CM gateway milestones M1 to M3, the ABHA, HPR and HFR registries, and UHI. Nothing here has been run against the ABDM sandbox unless a page says so, so treat request and response shapes as unconfirmed.

## docs/hiecm

- [API references](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api): Every operation published for this gateway, module by module.
- [Gateway session](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway): Every ABDM call carries a bearer token from one endpoint. This is that endpoint, plus the certificate and bridge registration calls that sit beside it.
- [Find Bridge Service by Service ID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-get-bridge-service-by-id): Look up a specific registered HIP/HIU service by its service ID.
- [Get Gateway JWKS Certificates](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-get-gateway-certs): Get the JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) to verify JWT signatures in gateway callbacks.
- [Get OIDC Discovery Document](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-get-oidc-config): OIDC discovery endpoint for the ABDM Gateway.
- [Get a provider by id](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-get-provider-by-id): Look up one provider by its provider id.
- [List All Bridge Services](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-list-bridge-services): List all HIP/HIU services registered under the authenticated bridge.
- [List government programs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-list-govt-programs): List government programs registered with the gateway. The response
- [List health-locker-enabled providers](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-list-health-lockers): List providers with health locker functionality enabled, optionally
- [List providers by name](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-list-providers): List ABDM-registered providers, optionally filtered by name.
- [Register / Update Bridge Services (HIU)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-register-bridge-services): Registers or updates one or more HIU service entries under a facility
- [Create a session and get an access token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-sessions-create): Send the client id and client secret from your ABDM sandbox
- [Update HIP/HIU Bridge Callback URL](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/endpoints/gateway-update-bridge-url): Register the HIP/HIU callback URL with the ABDM Gateway.
- [Gateway session errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/gateway/errors): What Gateway session returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [M1 ABHA identity](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1): M1 base URLs and the operations grouped by use case.
- [M1 APIs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/apis): The rules that hold across every M1 endpoint. Base URLs, how scope picks the job, RSA encryption, and the two token rule.
- [Find the Aadhaar number behind an ABHA number](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-benefit-find-aadhaar-by-abha): The reverse lookup. It returns a national identity number, so treat both

- [Get the benefit record for an ABHA number](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-benefit-get-by-abha): Reads the benefit record attached to one ABHA number.
- [Get the state and district recorded against an ABHA number](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-benefit-get-state-district): Used to route a person to the right scheme, since eligibility is often
- [Link or unlink a benefit record from an ABHA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-benefit-link-or-delink): One call does both directions. The success response names the

- [Find insurance cover recorded against an ABHA number](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-benefit-search-insurance): Documented responses include 400, 401 and 500 as well as 200. Handle

- [01 - Get Health Records List [GET]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-01-get-health-records-list-get): Lists the health records held in the person's DigiLocker.
- [02 - Get DigiLocker Account [GET]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-02-get-digilocker-account-get): Returns the DigiLocker account linked to the signed-in ABHA address, if one has been connected.
- [03 - Get Access Token / OAuth Callback [GET]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-03-get-access-token-oauth-callback-get): Completes the DigiLocker OAuth flow: exchanges the authorisation code DigiLocker redirected back with for an access token.
- [04 - Get Account Status [GET]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-04-get-account-status-get): Reports whether the person's DigiLocker account is connected and ready to receive records.
- [05 - Upload Record [POST]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-05-upload-record-post): Uploads a file the person holds into their DigiLocker as a health record.
- [06 - Read Uploaded Record [GET]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-06-read-uploaded-record-get): Returns the content of one record the person uploaded to DigiLocker.
- [07 - Fetch Incoming Records List [POST]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-07-fetch-incoming-records-list-post): Lists the records a HIP has sent to the person's DigiLocker within a date range.
- [08 - Fetch Incoming Records Bundle [POST]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-08-fetch-incoming-records-bundle-post): Fetches the FHIR bundle for one care context that a HIP has sent to the person's DigiLocker.
- [09 - Pull / Refresh Records [POST]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-09-pull-refresh-records-post): Asks a HIP to send the person's latest records to DigiLocker. The records arrive later; poll the refresh endpoint for them.
- [1. Get All States](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-1-get-all-states): Lists every state with its LGD code, for the address section of registration.
- [1. Request OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-1-request-otp): Starts ABHA address registration for a person who already holds an ABHA number, by sending an OTP. `loginId` is the encrypted ABHA number or Aadhaar.
- [1. Request OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-1-request-otp-2): Starts ABHA address registration for a person with no ABHA number, by sending an OTP to their mobile. `loginId` is the encrypted mobile number.
- [10 - Get HIP Refresh Records [GET]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-10-get-hip-refresh-records-get): Returns the records a refresh pulled from a HIP into DigiLocker, once the pull has completed.
- [2. Get Districts by State Code](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-2-get-districts-by-state-code): Lists the districts of a state, keyed by LGD code, for the address section of registration.
- [2. Verify Aadhaar](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-2-verify-aadhaar): Verifies the Aadhaar OTP for a registration transaction and records the person's consent to use Aadhaar for ABHA.
- [2. Verify OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-2-verify-otp): Verifies the mobile OTP for a registration transaction. `authData` carries the transaction id and the encrypted OTP.
- [3. PHR Address Suggestion](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-3-phr-address-suggestion): Suggests available ABHA addresses from the person's name and date of birth, for a mobile-based registration transaction.
- [3. Search LGD by Pin Code](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-3-search-lgd-by-pin-code): Resolves a PIN code to its state and district LGD codes, so the address can be filled from the PIN alone.
- [3. Verify Auth](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-3-verify-auth): Verifies the OTP for a registration transaction started against an ABHA number. `authData` carries the transaction id and the encrypted OTP.
- [4. Check PHR Address Existence](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-4-check-phr-address-existence): Checks whether an ABHA address is already taken before the person tries to register it.
- [4. Create Custom PHR Address](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-4-create-custom-phr-address): Creates an ABHA address of the person's own choosing, once the registration transaction has been verified.
- [5. Get PHR Suggestions](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-5-get-phr-suggestions): Suggests available ABHA addresses for the registration transaction, built from the person's verified profile.
- [5. Register Details](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-5-register-details): Completes mobile-based registration by submitting the person's profile details against the verified transaction, and creates the ABHA address.
- [assign](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-assign): Links another ABHA address to the signed-in person's address under a relationship type, so the two profiles are managed as a family.
- [Certificate](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-certificate): Returns the ABDM public key and the encryption algorithm to apply with it. Fetch it before encrypting any value for the PHR application services.
- [De-Link Request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-de-link-request): Removes the link between the signed-in ABHA address and an ABHA number, against a verified transaction.
- [delink](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-delink): Removes the family link between the signed-in person's ABHA address and the related address given.
- [ENCRYPTION](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-encryption): Encrypts a value with the ABDM public key so it can be sent in the fields that only accept ciphertext, such as `loginId` and OTP values.
- [Get District with stateCode](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-district-with-statecode): Lists the districts of a state with their LGD codes.
- [Get lgd with pincode](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-lgd-with-pincode): Resolves a PIN code to its state and district LGD codes.
- [Get notifications](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-notifications): Lists the notifications delivered to the signed-in ABHA address.
- [Get PHR Card](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-phr-card): Returns the person's ABHA card as an image for display or download.
- [Get Profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-profile): Returns the signed-in person's ABHA profile: name, date of birth, gender and contact details.
- [Get QR Code](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-qr-code): Returns the QR code that encodes the person's ABHA address, for scanning at a facility.
- [Get Relationship Types](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-relationship-types): Lists the relationship types an address can be assigned under, each with the id `assign` takes.
- [Get States](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-states): Lists every state with its LGD code.
- [getProvidersByID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-getprovidersbyid): Returns one provider's registry entry: its identifier, facility type, whether it acts as a HIP, and whether it supports scan and pay.
- [IsKycVerified](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-iskycverified): Reports whether the ABHA address given has completed KYC verification.
- [Link Request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-link-request): Links an ABHA number to the signed-in ABHA address, against a verified transaction.
- [linked-by-me](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-linked-by-me): Lists the ABHA addresses the signed-in person has linked to their own as family members.
- [linked-to-me](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-linked-to-me): Lists the ABHA addresses that have linked the signed-in person's address as a family member.
- [Login OTP Verify - AADHAR](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-login-otp-verify-aadhar): Verifies the login OTP. On success the response carries the accounts linked to the identifier and a token for each, or a transaction to pick one with.
- [Logout](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-logout): Ends the session and invalidates its tokens.
- [OTP Request - AADHAR OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-otp-request-aadhar-otp): Starts a login by sending an OTP. `loginHint` names what the person is identifying with, and `loginId` is that value encrypted.
- [reassign](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-reassign): Moves an existing family link to a different relationship type without delinking and assigning again.
- [Refresh Token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-refresh-token): Exchanges a refresh token for a new access token, so the session continues without signing in again.
- [Search Auth Methods - ABHAAddress](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-search-auth-methods-abhaaddress): Returns the authentication methods available for an ABHA address, so the login can offer only the ones that will work.
- [Send AADHAAR Otp - Link-DeLink](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-send-aadhaar-otp-link-delink): Sends an Aadhaar OTP to authorise linking or delinking an ABHA number with the signed-in address. `loginId` is the encrypted Aadhaar.
- [Send ABHA OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-send-abha-otp): Sends an OTP to the contact registered on the signed-in ABHA address, to authorise a profile change. `loginId` is encrypted.
- [Send ABHA Otp - Link-DeLink](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-send-abha-otp-link-delink): Sends an OTP to the ABHA number's registered contact to authorise linking or delinking an ABHA address. `loginId` is encrypted.
- [Session API](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-session-api): Issues a gateway session token from a client id and secret. The token is the bearer credential for calls on the gateway host.
- [Session-Token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-session-token): Issues the access token every PHR application call carries as a bearer token, with its refresh token and both expiry windows.
- [Set the preferred ABHA address](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-set-preferred-abha-address): Marks one of the person's ABHA addresses as the preferred one, against a verified transaction.
- [Switch Profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-switch-profile): Lists the other accounts the signed-in person can switch to and opens a transaction for the switch.
- [unassign](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-unassign): Ends the family relationship with the related ABHA address given, on the signed-in person's side.
- [Update mobile request OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-update-mobile-request-otp): Sends an OTP to a new mobile number so it can replace the one on the signed-in ABHA address. `loginId` is the encrypted new number.
- [Update mobile verify OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-update-mobile-verify-otp): Verifies the OTP sent for a mobile number update on an ABHA address. `authData` carries the transaction id and the encrypted OTP.
- [Update Profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-update-profile): Updates the signed-in person's profile fields: name, date of birth, gender, contact details and photo.
- [Verify AADHAAR Otp - Link-DeLink](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-verify-aadhaar-otp-link-delink): Verifies the Aadhaar OTP for a link or delink transaction and returns the accounts it applies to.
- [Verify ABHA OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-verify-abha-otp): Verifies the OTP sent for a profile change and returns the accounts and tokens it applies to.
- [verify and assign](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-verify-and-assign): Verifies the OTP for a family link transaction and, in the same step, links the given ABHA address under the relationship type. May also unassign a previous add
- [Verify - User](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-verify-user): Completes a login that matched more than one account: selects the ABHA address to sign in as and returns its session tokens.
- [Verify User Switch Profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-verify-user-switch-profile): Completes a profile switch: selects the ABHA address to continue as and returns its session tokens.
- [P1 PHR identity and profile errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/errors): What P1 PHR identity and profile returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [P2 PHR linking and records](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2): How a patient finds records held elsewhere and attaches them to their ABHA address.
- [01 discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-01-discovery): Discovers the person's care contexts at a HIP using their demographics and any identifiers they hold there.
- [02 link-init](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-02-link-init): Initiates linking of the care contexts discovered at a HIP. The HIP replies with how the person will authenticate.
- [03 link-confirm](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-03-link-confirm): Confirms a user-initiated link with the OTP the HIP sent, completing the link of the discovered care contexts.
- [Add My Record Bookmark](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-add-my-record-bookmark): Bookmarks a self-uploaded record by its care context reference.
- [AS - Record On Share](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-as-record-on-share): Callback the gateway sends with the outcome of a record share request.
- [AS - RecordShare](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-as-recordshare): Shares selected records with a facility after scanning its counter QR code.
- [AS - RecordShare History](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-as-recordshare-history): Lists the record shares the person has made, with the sending and receiving facilities and the counter they were shared at.
- [AS - RecordShare on-notify](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-as-recordshare-on-notify): Callback the gateway sends to notify the PHR that a record share has been acted on.
- [Bookmark Care Context](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-bookmark-care-context): Bookmarks a linked care context so it is easy to find again in the person's records.
- [call-back link-on-confirm](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-call-back-link-on-confirm): Callback the gateway sends after a link confirmation: the patient's linked care contexts, or the error that stopped it.
- [call-back on-discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-call-back-on-discovery): Callback the gateway sends with the care contexts discovered at the HIP, or the error that stopped discovery.
- [call-back on-init](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-call-back-on-init): Callback the gateway sends after a link is initiated: the link reference and how the person will authenticate, or the error that stopped it.
- [Delete My Record Bookmark](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-delete-my-record-bookmark): Removes a bookmark from a self-uploaded record.
- [Download File Chunk](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-download-file-chunk): Downloads one chunk of a record file. Use the metadata call for the chunk size.
- [Fetch Care Context Bundle URL](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-fetch-care-context-bundle-url): Returns the download URLs for the FHIR bundles of one linked care context, with the fetch status.
- [Fetch Health Information Status](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-fetch-health-information-status): Returns the transfer status for the transaction ids given.
- [Fetch Patient Health Information](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-fetch-patient-health-information): Fetches the health information received for the request ids given, with paging.
- [Get All Care Context Links for ABHA Address](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-all-care-context-links-for-abha-address): Lists the care context links for an ABHA address with paging and filters: HIP, record type, bookmarked, self-uploaded and date range.
- [Get All Linked Care Contexts](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-all-linked-care-contexts): Lists every care context linked to the signed-in person, grouped by HIP.
- [Get Care Context Links](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-care-context-links): Lists the care contexts linked to the signed-in person's ABHA address, with the HIP each came from.
- [Get Data Flow Part Status](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-data-flow-part-status): Returns the status of one part of a health information transfer, by its transaction id.
- [Get File Metadata](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-file-metadata): Returns a record file's name, size and chunk size, so it can be downloaded in parts.
- [Get Health Information by Transaction ID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-health-information-by-transaction-id): Returns the health information received for a transfer, by its transaction id.
- [Get HIP IDs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-hip-ids): Lists the HIPs whose records have been transferred for the person, with the base URL to download from.
- [Get Linked HIPs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-linked-hips): Lists the HIPs linked to the person whose records have not yet been transferred, with the base URL to download from.
- [Get Links by HIP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-links-by-hip): Lists the person's linked care contexts grouped by HIP.
- [Get Patient Transaction IDs by HIPs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-get-patient-transaction-ids-by-hips): Returns the transfer transaction ids for a person's records at the HIPs given, under the consent artefacts given.
- [Health Information Data Transfer (HIP to HIU)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-health-information-data-transfer-hip-to-hiu): Receives a page of encrypted health information from a HIP, with the key material needed to decrypt it. Pages arrive in sequence under one transaction id.
- [Health Information On-Request Callback](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-health-information-on-request-callback): Callback the gateway sends after a health information request: the transaction id for the transfer, or the error that stopped it.
- [Mark Linked Facility as Read](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-mark-linked-facility-as-read): Marks the records from one HIP as seen, clearing the unread indicator for that facility.
- [onpatientshare](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-onpatientshare): Callback the gateway sends after a profile share at a facility, acknowledging the share request.
- [PHR - Download File Chunk](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-download-file-chunk): Downloads one chunk of a record file. Use the metadata call for the chunk size.
- [PHR - Fetch Care Context Bundle URL](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-fetch-care-context-bundle-url): Returns the download URLs for the FHIR bundles of one linked care context, with the fetch status.
- [PHR - Get All Care Context Links](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-get-all-care-context-links): Lists every care context linked to the signed-in person, grouped by HIP.
- [PHR - Get Care Context Links](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-get-care-context-links): Lists the care contexts linked to the signed-in person's ABHA address, with the HIP each came from.
- [PHR - Get File Metadata](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-get-file-metadata): Returns a record file's name, size and chunk size, so it can be downloaded in parts.
- [PHR - Get Linked HIPs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-get-linked-hips): Lists the HIPs whose records have been transferred for the person, with the base URL to download from.
- [PHR - Pull Health Information for Care Context](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-pull-health-information-for-care-context): Asks a HIP to send the records for one care context. The data arrives later through the transfer endpoint.
- [PHR - Refresh Patient Health Information](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-refresh-patient-health-information): Asks the HIPs given to send any records added since the last transfer.
- [PHR - Save Care Context Bundle URL](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-phr-save-care-context-bundle-url): Records where the FHIR bundle for a care context was stored, with its fetch status.
- [Post Patient Consent Request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-post-patient-consent-request): Raises a consent request from the person's own PHR for records at the HIPs given, so they can be fetched into the app.
- [profile share](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-profile-share): Shares the person's profile with a facility after scanning its counter QR code, so the facility can register them without typing details.
- [Public -Get-Subscribed-Lockers-By-PatientId](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-public-get-subscribed-lockers-by-patientid): Lists the health lockers a person is subscribed to.
- [Public-Health-Lockers-Subscribe](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-public-health-lockers-subscribe): Subscribes the person to a health locker, so their new records are shared with it automatically.
- [Public-Health-Lockers-Unsubscribe](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-public-health-lockers-unsubscribe): Ends the person's subscription to a health locker, so it stops receiving their new records.
- [Pull Patient Health Information](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-pull-patient-health-information): Asks the HIPs given to send the person's records. The data arrives later through the transfer endpoint.
- [Refresh Patient Health Information](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-refresh-patient-health-information): Asks the HIPs given to send any records added since the last transfer.
- [Save Care Context Link](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-save-care-context-link): Records a care context link for a person, with the HIP it came from and whether its data has been transferred.
- [Search Care Context Links](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/endpoints/p2-search-care-context-links): Searches the person's care context links by the query parameters given.
- [P2 PHR linking and records errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p2/errors): What P2 PHR linking and records returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [P3 PHR consent and notifications](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3): How a patient grants, reviews and revokes consent, and how they are told any of it happened.
- [Add Feedback](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-add-feedback): Records feedback from the person, with a title and body, against their ABHA.
- [Add new Notification](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-add-new-notification): Creates a push notification for a person.
- [App Notification Token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-app-notification-token): Returns the device token registered for push notifications to the signed-in person.
- [Approve Consent Request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-approve-consent-request): Approves a consent request. `consents` names the HIPs and care contexts the person is granting, and the artefact ids come back.
- [Approve Subscription Request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-approve-subscription-request): Approves a subscription request for the sources included and not the ones excluded, or for every HIP.
- [Clear Notification](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-clear-notification): Clears the push notifications given from the person's list.
- [Consent Auto Approve](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-consent-auto-approve): Creates an auto-approval policy: consent requests from the HIU named are approved without asking, for the sources included and not the ones excluded.
- [Delete push notification](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-delete-push-notification): Deletes a scheduled push notification by its id.
- [Deny Consent Request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-deny-consent-request): Denies a consent request, with the reason the person gave.
- [Deny Subscription Request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-deny-subscription-request): Denies a subscription request, so the HIU is not notified of the person's new care contexts.
- [Disable Auto Approval](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-disable-auto-approval): Turns off an auto-approval policy, so later consent requests it would have matched wait for the person again.
- [Edit Subscription](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-edit-subscription): Edits a subscription and approves it in the same step, changing which HIPs and categories the HIU is subscribed to.
- [Enable Auto Approval](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-enable-auto-approval): Turns an auto-approval policy back on.
- [Get All Consent Artefacts by ABHA Address](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-get-all-consent-artefacts-by-abha-address): Lists the consent artefacts granted by the signed-in ABHA address, with paging.
- [Get All Consent Artefacts by Request ID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-get-all-consent-artefacts-by-request-id): Lists the consent artefacts created when a request was approved, one per HIP.
- [Get All HIU Subscription Requests](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-get-all-hiu-subscription-requests): Lists the subscription requests HIUs have raised against the signed-in ABHA address, with paging.
- [Get all notification details](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-get-all-notification-details): Lists the person's push notifications with their read state and the unread count.
- [Get Consent Artefact by Artefact ID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-get-consent-artefact-by-artefact-id): Returns one consent artefact with its signature and current status.
- [Get Consent Request by Request ID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-get-consent-request-by-request-id): Returns one consent request: who is asking, for what purpose, which record types, and its current status.
- [Get Consent Request List](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-get-consent-request-list): Lists the consent requests raised against the signed-in ABHA address, with paging.
- [Get Links](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-get-links): Lists the person's linked care contexts at the HIPs given, for choosing what to grant in a consent.
- [GET-scheduled push Notifications](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-get-scheduled-push-notifications): Lists the push notifications scheduled for later delivery, with their processing state.
- [Get Subscription Details by Request ID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-get-subscription-details-by-request-id): Returns one subscription request with its status and details, by the request id.
- [Get Subscription Details by Subscription ID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-get-subscription-details-by-subscription-id): Returns one subscription with its details, by the subscription id.
- [HIU Consent Notification](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-hiu-consent-notification): Notification the gateway sends a HIU when a consent request is granted, denied, revoked or expires.
- [HIU Consent Request On-Init (Callback)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-hiu-consent-request-on-init-callback): Callback the gateway sends after a consent request is raised: the request id to track it by, or the error that stopped it.
- [HIU On-Fetch (Consent Artefact Fetch Callback)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-hiu-on-fetch-consent-artefact-fetch-callback): Callback the gateway sends with a consent artefact the HIU asked to fetch, or the error that stopped it.
- [Init Consent Request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-init-consent-request): Raises a consent request as a HIU: names the patient, the purpose, the record types and the period of care wanted.
- [Initiate Subscription Request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-initiate-subscription-request): Raises a subscription request as a HIU: asks to be notified when the patient links new care contexts at the HIPs and categories named, for a period.
- [Post - add App Notification Token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-post-add-app-notification-token): Registers a device token for push notifications, with the operating system it belongs to.
- [Revoke Consent](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-revoke-consent): Revokes the consent artefacts given, so the HIUs holding them can no longer fetch under them.
- [Schedule-push-notification - internal](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-schedule-push-notification-internal): Schedules a push notification to a person for a given time, for example a medication reminder.
- [Set Up Subscription for Aarogya Setu](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-set-up-subscription-for-aarogya-setu): Sets up the PHR application's own subscription, so it is notified when the person links new care contexts.
- [Single/Multiple Notification read](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-single-multiple-notification-read): Marks one or more push notifications as read.
- [Update-scheduled push notification](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/endpoints/p3-update-scheduled-push-notification): Changes the delivery time of a scheduled push notification.
- [P3 PHR consent and notifications errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p3/errors): What P3 PHR consent and notifications returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [PHR application services](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services): Services a PHR application can offer on top of ABDM. Not a certification milestone.

- [1. on_search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-1-on-search): Callback carrying the teleconsultation providers and services that matched a search.

- [2. on_search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-2-on-search): Callback carrying the teleconsultation providers and services that matched a search.

- [2. Second Search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-2-second-search): Refines a teleconsultation search, for example by provider or time slot. Beckn `search` action; results arrive at `on_search`.
- [3. Init](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-3-init): Initialises a teleconsultation booking for the service selected. Beckn `init` action; the reply arrives at `on_init`.
- [3. on_init](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-3-on-init): Callback carrying the provider's reply to a teleconsultation `init`: the quote and the terms to confirm.
- [4. Confirm](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-4-confirm): Confirms a teleconsultation booking. Beckn `confirm` action; the reply arrives at `on_confirm`.
- [4.on_confirm](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-4-on-confirm): Callback carrying the provider's confirmation of a teleconsultation booking, with the order details.
- [5.On status](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-5-on-status): Callback carrying the current status of a teleconsultation order.
- [5. Status](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-5-status): Asks for the current status of a teleconsultation order. Beckn `status` action; the reply arrives at `on_status`.
- [6.on_cancel](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-6-on-cancel): Callback carrying the provider's reply to a teleconsultation cancellation.
- [6. On_update](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-6-on-update): Updates a teleconsultation order, for example to reschedule. Beckn `update` action; the reply arrives at `on_update`.
- [7 .On_message](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-7-on-message): Sends a message within a teleconsultation. Beckn `message` action.
- [7.on_update](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-7-on-update): Callback carrying the provider's reply to a teleconsultation update.

- [{{aarogya-setu-sandbox-url}}api/health/service/doctor/geo-location/search-within-radius](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-aarogya-setu-sandbox-url-api-health-service-doctor): Finds doctors within a radius of a point, filtered by name, speciality, facility ownership and type, with paging.
- [Create](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-create): Saves a place as a bookmark for the signed-in ABHA address, with a title, address and coordinates.
- [Delete](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-delete): Deletes one of the person's saved place bookmarks.
- [Get categories](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-categories): Lists the teleconsultation categories available to search in.
- [Get categories by id](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-categories-by-id): Returns one teleconsultation category by its id.
- [Get Category List](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-category-list): Lists the facility categories available for filtering a search.
- [get-coverage-eligibility](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-coverage-eligibility): Checks whether a person's insurance policy covers them, through the National Health Claims Exchange. The result arrives at `on_check`.
- [get details](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-details): Lists the person's scan and pay requests with the status, order number and transaction id of each.
- [Get Distinct Category List](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-distinct-category-list): Lists the distinct facility categories, with the care settings each offers.
- [Get Doctor Details](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-doctor-details): Lists the doctors at a facility, by the facility's search id.

- [get-policies](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-get-policies): Lists the insurance policies held against an ABHA number. `encryptedAbhaNumber` is the ABHA number encrypted.

- [notify status](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-notify-status): Returns the payment status of one scan and pay request, with the receipt link once paid.
- [on_check](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-on-check): Callback carrying the payer's answer to a coverage eligibility check.
- [On Search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-on-search): Callback carrying the PM-JAY empanelled facilities that matched a search.
- [on_submit](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-on-submit): Callback carrying the payer's answer to a policy search.
- [OPENORDER](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-openorder): Opens a scan and pay order after the person scans a facility's payment counter QR code.
- [order-status](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-order-status): Returns the status of a scan and pay order by its order number.
- [payment-order](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-payment-order): Creates the payment order for the procedures selected and returns the UPI intent to pay with.
- [Rest Search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-rest-search): Searches PM-JAY empanelled facilities and returns the results in the same call, without a callback.
- [search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-search): Searches a payer's records for a member's policy through the National Health Claims Exchange. The result arrives at `on_submit`.
- [Search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-search-2): Searches PM-JAY empanelled facilities. Beckn `search` action; results arrive at `on_search`.
- [search-doctor-by-id](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-search-doctor-by-id): Returns a doctor's registry profile by their ABHA number: registration, qualifications, system of medicine and experience.

- [STEP 2 - on_search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-step-2-on-search): Callback carrying the ambulance providers and services that matched a search.
- [STEP 3 - init](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-step-3-init): Initialises an ambulance booking for the service selected from search results. Beckn `init` action; the reply arrives at `on_init`.
- [STEP 4 - on_init](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-step-4-on-init): Callback carrying the provider's reply to an ambulance booking `init`: the quote and the terms to confirm.
- [subscribe](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-subscribe): Subscribes the PHR to National Health Claims Exchange notifications. Confirmation arrives at `on_subscribe`.
- [Update](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-update): Updates the title or address of a saved place bookmark.
- [update payment](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/endpoints/phr-services-update-payment): Records the outcome of a scan and pay payment: the amount, the transaction id and the receipt.
- [PHR application services errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/phr-services/errors): What PHR application services returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [Consent](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/consent): What a consent request is, what a consent artefact is, who holds it, and the states it moves through.
- [How a record travels](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/data-flow): The path a health record takes from the system that asks for it to the system that holds it, and the encryption in between.
- [Encryption](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/encryption): Which values must be encrypted before they go in a request body, why it is required, and why you encrypt inside your own system rather than through a helper.
- [FHIR and health record formats](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/fhir): The R4 profiles ABDM uses, the document bundle every record travels in, and how to validate one before you ship it.
- [The ABDM gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/gateway): The routing layer every ABDM call goes through, and the session endpoint that issues your token.
- [Hospital, lab and pharmacy systems](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/hip-hiu): What a health information provider does in ABDM, and how care context linking fits into a clinical workflow.
- [How the pieces fit](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/how-it-fits): The registries, the HIE-CM gateway and the roles your system takes, and where a health record actually lives.
- [Care contexts and linking](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/linking): What a care context is, why a record has to be linked before anyone can find it, and how the link token works.
- [Ecosystem participants](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants): The eight participants on India's health data network, the identifier each one holds, and what each can do.
- [Citizen](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/citizen): What an ABHA gives a person, what consent means in practice, and what a citizen controls on the network.
- [Doctor](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/doctor): The HPR ID a healthcare professional holds, how it is issued, and what it unlocks for the facility they work in.
- [Hospital](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/hospital): The facility ID a hospital holds, the HIP and HIU roles it takes, and what registering on ABDM gets it.
- [Insurer](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/insurer): An insurer reads records as an HIU under consent, and settles claims on NHCX, a separate gateway with its own onboarding.
- [Diagnostics](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/lab): A laboratory or imaging centre is a HIP like a hospital, with a narrower record surface. What differs and what does not.
- [NHA](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/nha): The National Health Authority runs ABDM. What we operate, what we issue, and what that gives the systems on the network.
- [Pharmacy](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/pharmacy): A pharmacy is a HIP like a hospital, with a narrower record surface. What differs, and what runs on another gateway.
- [PHR app](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/participants/phr): The citizen facing app: what identifies it, the three milestones it builds, and why it is where consent happens.
- [PHR applications](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/concepts/phr): What a personal health record app does in ABDM, the screens it needs, and the modules you have to build.
- [Get started](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started): Connect your application to India's health data network, from sandbox credentials to your first call to going live.
- [Build with AI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/build-with-ai): Set a coding agent up to build your ABDM integration, from a one-file skill to live retrieval over MCP.
- [Quickstart](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/first-fifteen-minutes): Create a gateway session and then create your first ABHA, live from this page, with your own sandbox credentials.
- [Glossary](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/glossary): The ABDM terms used across this documentation, and the HIE-CM ones, defined once.
- [Go live](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/going-live): Complete the sandbox exit process, two demonstrations, functional testing, the security audit and the exit form, then switch to production.
- [Get your sandbox credentials](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/sandbox): Register on the sandbox, collect your client id and secret, register a callback URL, and note the base URLs.
- [Security audit](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/security-audit): Pass the WASA security audit and hold a Safe to Host certificate, which every application needs before it runs in production.
- [Milestones](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones): The four milestones spell CARE. Create, Attach, Retrieve, Enrol, in build order, plus the three PHR milestones and what each role needs.
- [M1 Create: ABHA identity](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m1): What Milestone 1 gives you, what you need before your first call, and the order to build it in.
- [M2 Attach: linking and sharing](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m2): What Milestone 2 gives you, the prerequisites that block it, the record types you can link, and the order to build it in.
- [M3 Retrieve: consent and fetching](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m3): What Milestone 3 gives you, who asks the patient for consent, what you store, and the order to build it in.
- [M4 Enrol: facilities and professionals](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/m4): What Milestone 4 covers, who needs it, how the two registries connect, and why it blocks going live.
- [P1 Identity and profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/p1): The patient side of M1: how a person registers in your PHR app, logs in four ways, and holds their own profile and ABHA card.
- [P2 Linking and records](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/p2): The patient side of M2: how a PHR app finds records held elsewhere, links them to an ABHA address, and shares a profile at a facility.
- [P3 Consent and notifications](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/p3): The patient side of M3: subscriptions, auto approval, granting and revoking consent, and fetching the records a grant covers.
- [Authentication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/reference/authentication): The credentials every ABDM call carries, and the headers that go with them.
- [Sandbox data dictionary](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/reference/data-dictionary): The tables and columns behind the ABDM sandbox portal, grouped by what each one records.
- [Error codes](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/reference/error-codes): Every error code the specifications carry, with its message and what to do.
- [Registries](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/registries): What an ABDM registry is, why there are two, and where ABHA, HPR and HFR sit.
- [ABHA, the patient registry](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/registries/abha): The registry that identifies patients, the 14 digit ABHA number, the ABHA address, and what every milestone assumes about both.
- [NHPR, the provider registries](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/registries/nhpr): The National Health Professional Registry, why professionals and facilities are registered separately, and which one you need first.
- [HFR, the facility registry](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/registries/nhpr/hfr): The Health Facility Registry, what a facility record holds, the five call onboarding sequence, and how a bridge is linked to it.
- [HPR, the professional registry](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/registries/nhpr/hpr): The Healthcare Professionals Registry, the HPID, what identifies a doctor, and the registration journey.
- [When something breaks](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting): Find the symptom you are seeing, not the error code, and work through the checks in order.
- [Accepted, then nothing](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting/accepted-then-nothing): Discovery or care context linking started, the first call was accepted, and the flow stalled somewhere in the middle.
- [The callback never arrives](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting/callback-never-arrives): A call returned 202, and nothing followed on your registered callback URL. The checks in order.
- [Consent stuck in Requested](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting/consent-stuck-requested): A consent request was created and never moved to Granted or Denied. The checks in order.
- [Everything returns 401](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting/everything-returns-401): Every call fails the same way, not just one endpoint. The checks in order, before you assume the gateway is down.
- [The OTP never arrives](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/troubleshooting/otp-never-arrives): You requested an OTP and nothing reached the phone. The checks in order.

## docs/nhcx

- [NHCX](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1): What NHCX is, who is on it, and where to start depending on whether you are building a provider, a payer, or deciding whether to build at all.
- [API references](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api): Every operation published for this gateway, module by module.

- [Refresh the user token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/nhcx-biometric/endpoints/nhcx-biometric-auth-refresh-token): Extends the 30 minute user token through a long transaction. A refresh token is not accepted in place of a live capture on a cyclic procedure's per-visit authen
- [Verify the captured biometric](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/nhcx-biometric/endpoints/nhcx-biometric-auth-verify): Sends the captured PID block against the transaction opened by init. - [Poll for the captured face PID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/nhcx-biometric/endpoints/nhcx-biometric-faceauth-capture-pid): Polled after init until the patient has completed the capture in the ABHA app. Returns the PID block the verify call sends.
- [Start a face authentication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/nhcx-biometric/endpoints/nhcx-biometric-faceauth-init): Opens the face flow and returns a transaction id. The patient then scans a QR code in the ABHA app; the capture is collected by polling the PID endpoint below.
- [Verify a face capture against Aadhaar](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/nhcx-biometric/endpoints/nhcx-biometric-faceauth-verify): Completes the face flow. - [NHCX use case endpoints errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/nhcx-usecases/errors): What NHCX use case endpoints returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
- [Building a payer](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-payer): The insurer, TPA or scheme side: the queues each role works, what the system hosts, and the rules every answer obeys.
- [Adjudicating claims](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-payer/adjudicating-claims): The claim queue against the approved preauthorisation, the denial codes, appeals, and answering a regulator's search.
- [Adjudicating preauthorisation](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-payer/adjudicating-preauthorisation): The preauthorisation queue: what the adjudicator sees, what to validate on arrival, and how a decision becomes a ClaimResponse.
- [Payer sandbox checklist](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-payer/checklist): The fifteen use cases a payer demonstrates to leave the sandbox, the four validations on every response, and where payers go wrong.
- [Eligibility response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-payer/eligibility-response): The one exchange to answer without a human: four purposes, four answers, and what to validate before looking at coverage.
- [Payment notice and communication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-payer/payment-notice-and-communication): The two exchanges a payer starts: three payment notices as money moves, and the communication channel with its six reasons.
- [Policies and plans](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-payer/policies-and-plans): Linking beneficiaries to policies so providers can find them, and publishing the plan that drives every provider screen.
- [Payer UI guide](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-payer/ui-guide): The payer screens queue by queue: who works each one, what they decide, and how that decision becomes a message.
- [Building a provider](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-provider): The hospital's side of the exchange: the screens, the calls behind each one, and what a provider integration has to keep.
- [Provider sandbox checklist](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-provider/checklist): The thirteen use cases a provider demonstrates to leave the sandbox, what to test first, and where the first week goes wrong.
- [Discharge and claim](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-provider/discharge-and-claim): The provisional discharge submission and the final claim, the four dates they carry, and what to do after a decision.
- [Insurance plan](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-provider/insurance-plan): Fetching the policy as data, caching it with a version stamp, and building the treatment screen from the payer's own rules.
- [Payment and communication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-provider/payment-and-communication): The two exchanges the payer starts: payment notices with the UTR, and the communication inbox with its six reasons.
- [PMJAY provider](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-provider/pmjay-provider): Everything a PMJAY integration adds to the generic flow: biometrics, package flags, structured documents and scheme cases.
- [PMJAY sandbox run](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-provider/pmjay-sandbox-run): What the SHA HP sandbox actually accepted and refused over two days in September 2026, and what each refusal turned out to mean.
- [Preauthorisation](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-provider/preauthorisation): The first bundle carrying clinical content: the five form sections, what goes in the Claim, and how to read the answer.
- [Registration and eligibility](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-provider/registration-and-eligibility): The first screen: finding the policy, confirming cover before the patient is registered, and what to store from the answer.
- [Provider UI guide](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/building-a-provider/ui-guide): The provider screens flow by flow: what the user sees, what the UI must enforce, and where each value on screen comes from.
- [Core concepts](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/concepts): What a claim is made of on NHCX, and the concepts every integration depends on whichever side of the exchange you are building.
- [Claim settlement](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/concepts/claim-settlement): The ten steps of a health insurance claim, the parties to it, and the email-and-portal mechanism NHCX replaces.
- [JWE, status and errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/concepts/jwe-status-and-errors): The envelope and the sealed letter, every header field, the status words, receipts, and what to send when the sources disagree.
- [NHCX way of claim settlement](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/concepts/nhcx-way-of-claim-settlement): How the ten steps become structured exchanges: the request and callback pattern, and the six exchanges that carry a claim.
- [PMJAY on NHCX](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/concepts/pmjay-on-nhcx): What changes when the payer is PMJAY, why the scheme is moving off TMS, and the five stages of an integrator's journey.
- [PMJAY scheme rules](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/concepts/pmjay-scheme-rules): The scheme rules that change what goes in a bundle: unspecified, cyclic, medical, newborn, implant and stratification cases.
- [What NHCX is](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/concepts/what-nhcx-is): The exchange, what it aims to achieve, what it is made of, who is on it, and what changes for a hospital that joins.
- [Exchanges and codes](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/exchanges): Every NHCX exchange as prose, with the workflow code that separates transactions sharing one endpoint.
- [PMJAY use cases](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/exchanges/pmjay-use-cases): The D-series: what a PMJAY integration must fetch, prove and package around each of the shared NHCX endpoints.
- [NHCX use cases](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/exchanges/use-cases): Every NHCX exchange with its action endpoint, its callback and its workflow code, grouped by who drives it.
- [Workflow codes](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/exchanges/workflow-codes): Every workflow code with the status word it expects, by stage, with the lifecycle diagrams and the places sources disagree.
- [Bundles and conventions](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/bundles-and-conventions): The rules every NHCX FHIR bundle obeys before any use case: the collection bundle, profiles, references, ids and attachments.
- [Cancel, reprocess and shortfall](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/cancel-reprocess-and-shortfall): Three post-decision exchanges on one endpoint pair, told apart only by Task.code, with samples for one of the three.
- [Claim query and answer](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/claim-query-and-answer): A query is an ordinary ClaimResponse with outcome partial, and the answer is the whole claim bundle sent again.
- [Claim request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/claim-request): The same Claim as the preauthorisation with use switched, carrying the finalised dates, the bill and the full document set.
- [Claim response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/claim-response): The payer's adjudication of a claim, and the three ways every payer bundle differs from a provider one.
- [Codes and value sets](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/codes-and-value-sets): Every code an NHCX bundle uses with the system it belongs to, and the bindings the published samples get wrong.
- [Communication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/communication): The payer's asynchronous channel to the provider, specified field by field and with no sample bundle in either direction.
- [Coverage eligibility request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/coverage-eligibility-request): The provider's eligibility question as FHIR: six entries, the purpose that decides which question, and the fields that matter.
- [Coverage eligibility response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/coverage-eligibility-response): The payer's answer, which echoes your whole request back before answering it, and how to index it without reading your own data.
- [Insurance plan request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/insurance-plan-request): The smallest message on the exchange: one Task asking a payer for the plan behind a policy.
- [Insurance plan response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/insurance-plan-response): The two shapes a plan arrives in, which payer sends which, and the bundle, header and caching rules they share.
- [Insurance plan response, coverage-based](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/insurance-plan-response-coverage-based): The private-insurer shape: coverage, benefit and limit, with no published sample and what that leaves unconfirmed.
- [Insurance plan response, package-based](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/insurance-plan-response-package-based): The scheme shape, and the only one with a real payload: two parallel structures, 32 categories, sixteen flags per package.
- [Payment notice and acknowledgement](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/payment-notice-and-acknowledgement): The only exchange carrying real money: three notices as the transfer moves, the UTR, and the acknowledgement Task.
- [Preauthorisation enhancement](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/preauthorisation-enhancement): An enhancement is a preauthorisation bundle with one more item. Nothing in the payload says which it is.
- [Preauthorisation query and answer](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/preauthorisation-query-and-answer): There is no query resource. The question travels as free text in an adjudication and the answer as a whole resubmitted bundle.
- [Preauthorisation request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/preauthorisation-request): The first bundle carrying clinical content, its 31 entries, and what the live sandbox proved about the sample's oddities.
- [Preauthorisation response](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/preauthorisation-response): The payer's decision as a ClaimResponse, the three elements every sample is missing, and why the beneficiary comes back changed.
- [Predetermination, status and search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/predetermination-status-and-search): Three exchanges defined by the specification and never observed, documented as far as the specification goes and no further.
- [Sample bundles](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/fhir-reference/sample-bundles): The twenty-two real payloads every chapter here is built on: where they are, what each is, and the eight gaps they leave.
- [The base framework every participant builds](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started): The seven things every NHCX participant builds before any use case: token, keys, participant record, addressing, sealing, callbacks.
- [Building and sending a JWE](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/building-and-sending-a-jwe): Assembling the protected header, sealing a FHIR bundle for the recipient, and posting it to the exchange.
- [Finding participants and policies](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/finding-participants-and-policies): Listing payers by role, looking up a patient's policies, and reading the processor code every later message is addressed to.
- [Glossary](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/glossary): The ABDM terms NHCX shares. The gateway's own vocabulary has a glossary of its own in the reference section.
- [NHCX adapter](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/nhcx-adapter): A binary that speaks the protocol for you, so your system exchanges plain FHIR over its own network.
- [Glossary](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/nhcx-glossary): The NHCX and PMJAY terms this documentation uses, in the sense it uses them, with NHA's sense where it differs.
- [Creating and updating a participant record](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/participant-record): Creating your identity on the exchange in sandbox and in production, and updating the certificate or callback address.
- [Receiving a callback](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/receiving-a-callback): Hosting the endpoint every answer arrives on, returning the receipt in time, and opening the sealed message.
- [Fetching a recipient's certificate](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/recipient-certificate): Fetching and caching the public key of the participant you are about to send a message to.
- [Session token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/session-token): Getting a bearer token from the ABDM gateway with your Milestone 1 credentials, and keeping it fresh.
- [Your certificate](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/getting-started/your-certificate): Making the RSA key pair and self-signed X.509 certificate that lets other participants seal messages for you.
- [Authentication](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/authentication): The credentials every ABDM call carries, and the headers that go with them.
- [Error codes](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/reference/error-codes): Every error code the specifications carry, with its message and what to do.
- [Registries](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/registries): The participant registry NHCX runs, the three identifiers a participant holds, and how ABDM's own registries appear on this gateway.
- [Participants and policies](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/registries/participants-and-policies): How a participant joins the network and is found on it, and how a beneficiary is matched to a policy and its processor.

## docs/support

- [Support](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/support): Where to ask about the sandbox, and what to put in a report.

## docs/uhi

- [Introduction](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1): What UHI is, the two roles you can build, and how far each service goes today.
- [UHI API reference](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/api): What is published for the UHI gateway today, and where the message shapes come from.
- [UHI gateway](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/network-and-protocol): The open network for discovering and booking health services, its two roles, and its signing scheme.
- [Ambulance booking](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/ambulance-booking): Find an ambulance nearby and get a quote from the provider, using the two call pairs live in this service today.
- [AMRIT Pharmacy discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/amrit-pharmacy): Find AMRIT Pharmacy stores over UHI by store code, state and district, pincode or GPS radius.
- [Blood bank discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/blood-bank): Search live blood stock by group and component across registered blood banks, using one call pair.
- [Jan Aushadhi Kendra discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/jan-aushadhi-kendra): Find Jan Aushadhi Kendras over UHI by Kendra code, state and district, pincode or GPS radius.
- [Jan Aushadhi medicine search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/jan-aushadhi-medicine-search): Search the Jan Aushadhi medicine catalogue, then find the Kendras that stock a chosen medicine.
- [Physical consultation](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/physical-consultation): Doctor discovery, appointment booking, PIN check-in and the full appointment lifecycle on UHI.
- [PM-JAY HEM hospital discovery](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/concepts/services/pmjay-hem): Find PM-JAY empanelled hospitals over UHI by state, district, speciality, facility name, pincode or GPS.
- [Glossary](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/getting-started/glossary): The ABDM terms UHI shares, and the two roles that belong to UHI alone.
- [Onboarding to UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/getting-started/onboarding): How an application joins the UHI network, from the M2 gate to sandbox sign-off and production go-live.
- [Registries](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/registries): The registry UHI runs itself, the three ABDM identifiers that ride inside UHI messages, and which of them onboarding actually asks for.
- [ABHA on UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/registries/abha): Where a patient's ABHA address appears in UHI messages, in which services it is mandatory, and what UHI does not do with it.
- [HFR on UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/registries/hfr): The one UHI service that carries an HFR ID, the tag it travels in, and what is issued at onboarding.
- [HPR on UHI](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/uhi/v1/registries/hpr): Where a practitioner's HPR ID appears in a UHI catalogue and a UHI order, and the two forms it takes.
